title: Cert provisioning: USB/BLE cert injection flow
description: Design and implement the cert provisioning flow for getting CA-signed attestation certs onto nodes. Paths: (1) USB: node exposes CSR generation via LCI, cert signed externally, injected back via LCI. (2) BLE: same flow over BLE transport. (3) Build-time: cert baked into firmware image at flash time. (4) ACME-like: node requests cert from CA endpoint via gateway (spec §8.13 mentions /.well-known/cert). The private key never leaves the node — node generates keypair, exports CSR or public key, receives signed cert. Spec the CSR format and the injection CoAP resource.
